custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test whose quantities allow fractions, at a cost of $10.00, with 2.5 in bin location A and 0 in bin location B, so the report has two bins to add up.
  • Add 1.25 of part A to a work order line from bin location B while it holds 0, so bin location B goes to -1.25 and part A's net is 1.25.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value under PARTS in the left menu), with the as-of date on today.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425666 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425666-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 2.5. Click Add Bin Location, pick a second bin location in the new row and type 0 as its Quantity, and click Default on that row. Click Save.
  2. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425666 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  3. Put part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425666-A in Part number and pick the result that shows Inventory Qty. Type 1.25 in Qty *. Click Save.
